title: Marangoni droplets: the negative (no self-propulsion; every run ends static) replicates on fresh seeds 7 and 8 and at dt/2, but the division-tuning numbers do not: alpha=0 gives 2 and 0 persistent splits there, not 10-12
summary: Re-ran the world unchanged on fresh seed 7 with alpha +20, 0 and -20, on seed 8 with alpha 0, and on seed 7 with alpha +20 at dt/2. No arm self-propels, and every run ends static. Alpha +20 ends as a frozen lattice (36-37 bodies) after an early phase of shredded clusters. Alpha 0 ends as arrested dumbbells: 4 on seed 7 (2 persistent splits), and 2 elongated bodies with 0 splits on seed 8. Alpha -20 gives hollow annular droplets that grow slowly and break into 4 droplets near t=19000 (0 persistent splits). The ordering +20 > 0 > -20 in splits holds on seed 7 (4/2/0 persistent), but the counts and regimes differ sharply from the claim's seeds 0/1 (14/10-12/6, generation 2-3, lattices in every arm). The division effect is strongly seed-dependent through the planted founders' positions. The max of 4.0 body lengths at alpha +20 comes from shredded clusters drifting during fragmentation, not from a swimming droplet.

observations.finding: No self-propulsion in any arm: rerun_a0/seed7 and rerun_am20/seed7 max speed 0, 1.0 and 0.3 body lengths; rerun_a0/seed8 0.5 BL; rerun_a20/seed7 4.0 BL only while shredded clusters fragment (t<7000, sheet), then a static lattice from t~7900 to 20000. Same at dt/2 (rerun_a20_dt2/seed7: 3.5 BL, lattice from t~8700)

seeds_run.result: pass (negative reproduced): alpha +20/0/-20 all end static; persistent splits 4/2/0, generation 1/1/0 (not the claim's 14/10-12/6)
pass (negative reproduced): alpha 0, two arrested dumbbells, 0 splits, 0.5 BL
pass at dt/2 (alpha +20): same path, 4 persistent splits, 37 final bodies, 3.5 BL

controls_run.finding: alpha 0 and -20 on seed 7 (rerun_a0, rerun_am20), alpha 0 on seed 8, dt/2 at alpha +20 (rerun_a20_dt2)

verdicts.limitation: The secondary result, that alpha tunes division, is not robust. On fresh seeds the alpha 0 arm barely divides (2 and 0 persistent splits), droplets arrest as dumbbells or rings, and the regime depends on the planted founders. Only the sign ordering on seed 7 survives. The shredded clusters at alpha +20 and the annuli at alpha -20 carry fine grid-scale hatching and crosshair streaks along the axes (rerun_a20/seed7 t=2700-5200). They persist at dt/2, so they are spatial; no resolution test was run. Two planted founders per run (not from noise).
